mainEntity.name: Should I use regular drywall or moisture-resistant drywall in a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in most basements you should use standard drywall on framed interior walls, but moisture conditions matter. If the space has humidity, splash risk, or past water issues, a mold-resistant or moisture-ready board may be a better fit for those areas. The right choice depends on the basement’s actual conditions, not just the room use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use the board type that matches the moisture risk. Standard drywall works in many framed basement walls, but mold-resistant or moisture-resistant board is often smarter for damp or humid basements.
